method: q442 ("do you think of Mormonism as a Christian religion, or is it not a Christian religion?") asked of Mormon respondents; don't know/refused kept IN the base as its own segment (not excluded), matching Pew's own published topline treatment of this question. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable. The "U.S. general public" row is copied verbatim from Pew's own published comparison (a November 2011 survey of non-Mormons this site does not hold microdata for) - not computed from this dataset.
